voice.name: Open Sector - Mortarman
voice.description: Middle-aged male mortar crewman in his fifties, warm husky voice with a soft Scottish-style lilt, fatherly and methodical, a former schoolteacher who treats ballistics like arithmetic, mild and polite but slightly half-deaf from the noise so he speaks a little loud, dry understated humor.
voice.sample: Mortarman here. Right then, give me the grid and a moment to plant the tube. Angle, charge, and a wee bit of patience. Up she goes, and down she comes, exactly where she ought to. Simple sums, really.

fire.prompt: A World War 2 mortar firing in an open field: a deep hollow thump as the bomb leaves the tube, then a faint whistle as it flies away.

move.prompt: Soldier jogging on dirt carrying a mortar tube and baseplate, metal clanking and gear rattling, short burst of footsteps, close, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Mortar baseplate thumped into dirt, bipod legs opened with metal clicks, tube locked in place, close up, no music, no voice
